note: What the Cookbook's files assert that is a claim or a normalization (the second layer of the 0.1 contract, docs/REQUIREMENTS.md), held here for now and marked provisional (REQ-004; Sean, 2026-10-07). Each entry names where the value lives today, what kind of assertion it is, who stands behind it and on what basis, where it is to live once the corpus can hold it, and the requirement that moves it. Nothing here is migrated yet; the build publishes this file with the data, and cookbook/checks.py fails if a file gains a field of this kind that is not listed.

fields.what: a classification of the preparation (oil, unguent, incense, fat, other), used by the index's facet
fields.home: a classification claim on the corpus recipe or its product term

fields.what: membership of a recipe family, and the family's English name
fields.basis: the cluster files at the pinned commit

fields.what: the amount as printed, parsed into a number and a unit; relative amounts ('the same number') resolved to a presumed figure where flagged
fields.claimant: the Cookbook's drafting, from perfume-tables preparations
fields.basis: the printed amount, kept beside it in ingredients[].printed
fields.home: the corpus recipe's quantities, anchored to the occurrence of the amount; a disputed amount (disputed: true) as competing readings (2026-10-07p)

fields.what: the headword each ingredient form instantiates; where Sean has ruled the word's own lemma otherwise (cookbook/lemma_claims.json, 2026-10-07m, R10), this field names the thing the ingredient is, our identification, not the word's lemma
fields.claimant: perfume-tables preparations, corrected by the Cookbook's drafting (the corrections are flagged)
fields.basis: the form as it stands in the text

fields.what: an English rendering chosen for one occurrence, overriding the headword's
fields.basis: the approved English of the passage
fields.home: a renders claim on the occurrence

fields.what: the material group a headword is filed under in the filter (resin, flower, leaf …)
fields.basis: none recorded; each group mapped onto the corpus kinds in cookbook/REVIEW.md
fields.home: a classification claim on the material (Sean to rule on groups and kinds)

fields.what: the record kind of a headword (raw material, processed material, product, tool, instrument)
fields.basis: the lexicon at the pinned commit

fields.what: a headword's English name, the rendering shown, its basis, and the translators' renderings
fields.claimant: Alchemies of Scent and the translators named in each entry
fields.basis: perfume-tables lexicon.json and the approved English, as recorded in basis
fields.home: renders claims, one per translator and occurrence
the corpus term's lexicon link (the lexicon's glosses as renderings, from extraction-pipeline)

fields.what: the metric value of each ancient unit
fields.claimant: Hultsch 1882 for the litra and oungia (from the corpus's units); the project's Weights and Measures Calculator for the rest
fields.basis: for the mina and the volume units, a spreadsheet that cites no source ('conventional value')
fields.home: unit records in the corpus, each value a normalization claim with its authority

fields.what: 0.91–0.92 g/ml, used to turn a volume of oil into grams on the family pages
fields.basis: an assumed figure, from neither units source
fields.home: a normalization claim (subject: olive oil; value with range; basis; claimant)

fields.claimant: the scholars named in each entry, as extracted by extraction-pipeline (machine-extracted, unreviewed there)
fields.basis: each claim of the pinned packages read by its id; headwords met when the same word folded, or through the lemmatiser once Sean accepts the join (cookbook/joins.json)
fields.home: the corpus's identification claims, through lemma claims on both sides (2026-10-07f)
